item: Elections calendar at the coverage floor: every floor country's tier stated, and the snapshot converter that layers under the curated entries (A2, S06-04 S1)
summary: country_tier_report states one of six states per floor country (scheduled, window, projected_upcoming, projected_passed, dateless, missing) with the reason a value is absent; snapshot_to_events converts Wikidata-shaped rows and carries a day only for a day-precision date with an official source (otherwise a labelled window; no date is null with a reason); layer() shadows snapshot rows under curated entries and returns every shadowed row. Fixtures only: the real roster waits on the operator's networked build. Not done: the Agenda-rail wiring in src/events/feeds.py and app-agenda.js (awaiting the OSM lane's ack), the Wikidata generator, the x12 UI strings.
